volume_2x.label: Volume 2×
volume_2x.note: Book A volume and risk volume doubled; price path and pool L unchanged.

volume_3x.label: Volume 3×
volume_3x.note: Book A volume and risk volume tripled.

fee_2x.label: Fee tier 2×
fee_2x.note: Book A 0.05% -> 0.10%; Book B 0.30% -> 0.60%. Protocol-level fee change, not a volume change.

volume_2x_fee_2x.label: Volume 2× + fee 2×
volume_2x_fee_2x.note: Both the activity and the fee tier double.

risk_150.label: More arm (vol 150)
risk_150.note: Risk volatility threshold lowered to 150 bps; the allocator moves to the arm sooner.

risk_500.label: More book (vol 500)
risk_500.note: Risk volatility threshold raised to 500 bps; the allocator stays in the book longer.

book_b_10x.label: Book B volume 10×
book_b_10x.note: Book B volume/risk volume 10x; Book A unchanged. Shows whether the thin pool becomes usable.

arm_high.label: Arm yield 5% + 5%
arm_high.note: USDG lend 5% APR, NVDA net 5% APR, borrow 3%; same caps.

arm_stress.label: Arm stress
arm_stress.note: USDG 103.73%, borrow 107.29%, borrow liquidity $15.1k; the high-utilization market.
